text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes... I did it! I totally nailed 
this test too, number o—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Scarlet! As expected of you. I heard 
you took top of the grade on that last 
test too? Congrats!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And you've been taking 1st place in mock 
races nonstop lately, haven't you? You're 
in top form!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, thanks! I've gotta keep this 
momentum going and work even harder♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Not letting it get to your head, I 
see. That's so you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well then, how about taking a breather 
once in a while? I'm going out to hang out 
with Sweep, wanna come along?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, look, look! It's Magical 
Time☆Dancing!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh~, a competitive dance game, huh. With 
all these sparkly visual effects synced 
up, it really looks like you're casting 
magic...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I wanna try that one next! Scarlet, why 
don't you play with me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Me? Fufu, sure thing!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(I've been in peak condition lately after 
all. I'm totally gonna win this!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hyah!! Then right here... like this!! 
Magical☆Miracle☆Danciiing☆!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ I wiiin~~~♪ Fufun, when it comes to 
magical girl dances, there's no way I'd 
lose!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...!? Even though I've been doing 
so great recently—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Guhhh...! One more time! One more round, 
Sweep!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me♪ I'll take you on as many times 
as you want!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Nngh~... 5 wins, 5 losses, and 5 draws... 
In the end, I couldn't even get ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that fine? Looked like you had 
plenty of fun. You did fine!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I mean, yeah, sure... but...

One day, I spotted Daiwa Scarlet near the 
arcade.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: *Haa*... *haa*... I can't accept this!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I am the horse girl who will be number 
one!! I'm not letting things end on a 
stupid draw!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What is it, Scarlet? Calling me out out of 
the blue like this.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You finally made it. We're having a 
rematch, Sweep! Until we settle this once 
and for all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That dance game from before? Fufun♪ Fine, 
I'll take you on.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Magical! Dance! Make! Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Step here! Hah... hah! I'm gonna do this!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way! Why, how!? My magic isn't 
working anymore!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Gununuu~... How did you improve so fast?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You used magic, didn't you? A rapid growth 
spell!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
True, I grinded hard so I could beat you. 
But the one who cast that spell was you— 
by lighting a fire under my competitive 
spirit!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet... H-Hmph. Well, if that's how it 
is—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, why are you inserting another 
coin?! I said we're done!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We're not done yet. Not until I take 1st 
place in this entire arcade!

Daiwa Scarlet continued playing after 
that, eventually smashing the high score 
and completely blowing everyone else away.
